title: [FS Integration] SVCITEM-CUSTASSET mapping ignores "Convert to Customer Asset" flag — every Service Item synced to FS unconditionally
summary: Field Service Integration now respects the Dataverse Product setting Convert to Customer Asset when syncing Service Items, preventing unconditional synchronization unless the flag is enabled or records are already coupled.
key_points: Service Items are now filtered based on the Convert to Customer Asset flag in the linked Dataverse Product
Already-coupled Service Item/Customer Asset pairs continue syncing regardless of the flag to avoid disruption
The fix exposes the msdyn_converttocustomerasset field and adds post-filter logic to OnQueryPostFilterIgnoreRecord
Service Items without Item numbers or uncoupled Items are not blocked by the new filter
Automated tests cover filtering behavior for enabled/disabled conversion and edge cases
quote: Service Items were synced to Field Service Customer Assets without honoring the Dataverse Product setting Convert to Customer Asset.
